member.name: T:NodeEditor.Core.Commands.UndoStack
member.summary:
Undo/redo stack for editor commands. Owned by the editor; not the host.
The editor produces inverse commands by snapshotting affected state BEFORE applying mutation. The host's command sink is consulted to apply the inverse on undo/redo.
Important semantics:
One user action = one stack entry. Multi-step ops wrap in Batch.
Transient drag updates do not push entries; only the final committed move does.
On wholesale external change the stack is cleared.
